༄༅/ /gnam chos dgongs gter las dbang phyug ma yi zor mdos khyer bde bar bkod pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gnam chos dgongs gter las dbang phyug ma yi zor mdos khyer bde bar bkod pa bzhugs so//

sarba dz+nyā na dhā ki na mo/ dgongs gter rdo rje'i gsungs las bkod pa'i don// dbang phyug ma yi zor mdos bsdus pa bkod// dhā ki rnams kyis bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs// mdos gdan g.yang gzhi gang yang rung ba'i steng*// dbus su zor chen gcig gi phyogs bzhi ru// kong zor de las chung ba bzhi yis bskor// de rgyab kong zor chung ngu nyi shu brgyad// bsdus na nyer brgyad bzhi la bsdu bar bya// kong zor rnams ni kong bu zur gsum dbyibs// nang du zor med dmar gtor chung ngu re// zur gsum rtsang de rtse gsum bsnol la gzug /zhib par dpe'u ris la bltas pas gsal// gal chen yod na shog ling bris nas kyang*// g.yang gzhi dang ni mdos snod bar du bzhag /bsdu na zan ling gcig bzhag mgo mdun du// zor chen mdun du bzhag pas 'thus pa yin// sha khrag mtshe dang yungs dkar sgang bus brgyan// de ni zor bsgrub zor mdos bca' chog ste// bka' gtad rkyang par zor chung lnga yi chog /zor mdos de la zor khebs zur gsum bkab: lha gzhung sngon du song nas zor mdos bran// 'di la bsnyen dang sgrub pa las sbyor gsum// dang po bsnyen pa bya ba'i rim pa ni// ye nas dam tshig pa dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin: rang nyid mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag gri thod 'dzin pa gar stabs mdzad pa: thugs kar nyi steng sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba: de'i mdun du ma mo mkha' 'gro lha srin thams cad sprin ltar 'khrigs nas las bsgrub par gyur: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa: brgya las mi nyung ci mang bsnyen par bya/ skad cig gis rang nyid gnas 'gyur nas bdag dang mdun bskyed zor dang rtsang rnams so sor: mkha' 'gro byad zlog ma sku mdog lcags sreg lta bu: gnam lcags kyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: khro mo'i chas thams cad rdzogs pa phyag gnyis zangs gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa:

sku smad lcags sreg gi phur pas ban bon nyams pa'i snying gar gzir ba: de'i shar du dkar mo seng gdong: lhor ser mo stag gdong: nub tu dmar mo dred gdong: byang du nag mo dom gdong: thams cad kyang gtso mo lta bu rang rtags kyis mtshan pa'i zangs gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa: seṅge dang stag dang dred dang dom gyi shun pa gyon pa sku smad lcags sreg gi phur pa can: 'khor dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba'o: bdag mdun thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs: bh+yo: mu le mtsho dang yongs 'du'i shing: dur khrod brgyad sogs bzhugs gnas nas: byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang: dbang mo nyer brgyad spyan 'dren no: sdang dgra'i steng du dgyes par bzhugs: oṃ sarba pañtsa dhā ki bh+yo sa ya si hrīṃ dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa yi: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: bshos bu gzugs sgra dri ro dang: reg bya sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs: byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang: dbang mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: 'khor bcas mnyes shing tshims gyur cig: oṃ pañtsa dhā ki bh+yo sa ya si a mṛta ba liṃ ta rak+ta khā hi khā hi: ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shab+da āḥhūm̐: bh+yo: chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: 'gro ba'i don du skur sprul nas: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshul: ma dang sring ltar sgrub la brtse: byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang: dbang mo nyer brgyad la bstod do: dam rdzas mchod gtor thugs dam bskang: thugs dang 'gal ba mthol zhing bshags: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: yams nad rims nad zhi ba dang: 'bru dang rkang 'gros 'phel rgyas mdzod: 'dod rgu thams cad dbang du sdus: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ma g.yel myur du las mdzod cig: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: lha mo lnga yi thugs ka ru: hūm̐ḥ.a hrī niḥsaḥyis mtshan: gtso 'khor kun gyis sngags kyi sgra:

'brug stong ldir ba ltar du bzlas: ri rab 'gul zhing rgya mtsho 'khyoms: lha srin sde brgyad sngangs shing 'dar: byad mas byas pa'i bsam sbyor kun: kho rang thog tu log ste song: sku las gnam lcags drag po'i thog: tshwa tshwa'i tshul du dpag med 'phros: gnod byed thams cad gzhob tu bsreg: sku smad lcags sreg phur pa ni: gnod byed rnams kyi snying gar gzir: sgo gsum nus pa bcom par gyur: de ltar bsgom zhing sngags 'di nyid// ci nus bzlas pas 'grub pa yin// bh+yo hūm̐ tri ma nu khrom bh+yo: du du tsa sha nan: a ka ma ni khroṃ bh+yo: shad bu gyad bu nan: sa ra ma ni khroṃ bh+yo: tra ni tra ni nan: ni li dha ra khroṃ bh+yo: tri phuṃ tri phuṃ nan: tri sha tra khroṃ bh+yo: dun ting du nan: a hrī ni sa bh+yo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya phaṭa: de nas zor mdos yin na ni// dbang phyug ma'i sngags 'di brjod/ bh+yo sa ya si bh+yo: de ni ci lcogs bzlas par bya// 'di yi bka' gtad byed pa na// 'di yan brjod rjes zor lnga po// rim bzhin lag tu gtad nas kyang*// phyogs gtsang phyogs su 'phen du 'jug /de nas maṇ+ḍal phul bar bya// des ni 'di yi bka' gtad thob// zor bsgrub zor mdos gang yang rung*// zor mdos yin na gso bran bya// thugs dam bskang bar ma byas na// byad dbang zlog par mi 'gyur bas// de phyir dang po bskang ba ni// hūm̐/ ma mo kun gyi yang rje mo// ye shes mkha' 'gro byad zlog ma// 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas// srid pa'i zor mdos gzhung bzhin bshams// dmar gtor sha khrag rtsang gis brgyan// mtshe dang yungs dkar sgang bu btsugs// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i spyan lam du// ci 'dod mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs// byad kha zlog pa'i mthu mo che// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// seng gdong dkar mo'i thugs= stag gdong ser mo'i thugs=

dred gdong dmar mo'i thugs= dom gdong nag mo'i thugs= mkha' 'gro'i bka' sdod srung ma ni// dbang phyug ma tshogs thugs= mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ba'i phyir// shar gyi ma bdun thugs= tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i phyir// lho yi ma bdun thugs= khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// nub kyi ma bdun thugs= drag po'i las rnams mthar phyin phyir// byang gi ma bdun thugs= byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang*// dbang mo nyer brgyad thugs dam bskang*// bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang*// sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol// sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor// ye sgrol ye sbyor chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// rgyu mchog chen po rnam lnga dang*// mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan dang*// rang byung dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang*// rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang*// rak+ta dmar gyi dgyes mchog dang*// sha chen spos kyi dam rdzas dang*// rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang*// snang gsal zhun mar mdangs ldan dang*// mkha' lding mdangs dang shel sgong mdangs// tsa ra 'di yi mdangs kyis bskang*// 'di ltar bskang bskang gsol gsol nas// thugs dam gnyan po des bskangs la// cho ga lhag chad rdzogs gyur cig /bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig /g.yar dam bskangs la rkyen dbang zlogs// ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang*// dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi// thugs dang 'gal ba gang gyur pa// mthol lo bshags so bzod par gsol// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// ces dang yig brgya bzlas/ de nas smad las zlog pa/ oṃ/ kaṃ las byung ba'i zor rgod rnams// gnam lcags khang sgrom zur gsum pa// de nang dgra bgegs byad ma rnams// mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i steng*// rtsang rnams mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ma// de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis// dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad ni// sbur ma rlung gis bsdu ba ltar// bsdus nas zor kong nang du thim// hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ

las kyi mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can/ khri 'bum bye ba sa ya rnams// kun kyang srog gi bdag mo ste/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs// da lta nam gyi gung shed la// 'byung ba chu yang gnyid log gis// dam nyams dgra bo gnyid du song*// bla tshe 'khyams po khrid la shog /ro nyal byas pa'i srog rtsa chod// zho ltar dkrugs la snying rtsa drongs// gru gsum lcags kyi khang pa 'dir// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis khrid la shog /las dbang drag pos khrid la shog /bh+yoḥ las kyi mkha' 'gro khyed rnams kyis// dgra bo'i snying nas lcags kyus drongs// dgra bo'i ske nas zhags pas chings// dgra bgegs yan lag lcags sgrog sdoms// dgra bo'i rgyab nas dril bus phul// dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la babs// sarba dhā ki nī dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nri mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ nri aṅku sha dzaḥdzaḥ thums ri li li dzaḥdzaḥ mkha' 'gro'i sku smad phur pa'i dbal// zug pas gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral// zor kong dgra bgegs sha khrag gis// gang ba mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gsol// oṃ sarba dz+nyā na dhā ki pañtsa shwa rī ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ rak+ta khā hi/ tsit+ta khā hi/ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ hūm̐: byad zlog lha mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: sangs rgyas rigs kyi byad ma zlog: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: a: seng gdong dkar mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: rdo rje rigs kyi byad ma zlog: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hrī: stag gdong ser mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: rin chen rigs kyi byad ma zlog:

nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ni: dred gdong dmar mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: pad+ma rigs kyi byad ma zlog: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: sa: dom gdong nag mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: karma rigs kyi byad ma zlog: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro byad zlog mas// 'du ba rnam bzhi dgra la zlogs// bad kan dmar smug dgra la= mkhris pa bshal yams dgra la= rlung gang 'phyo ba dgra la= khrag dang 'dus pa dgra la= bh+yoḥ shar gyi dkar mo seng gdong mas// smyo nad nyer lnga dgra la= smyo 'bog brgyal nad dgra la= 'gyur bu 'dar bu dgra la= rlung smyo chen po dgra la= bh+yoḥ lho yi ser mo stag gdong mas// mdze rigs bco brgyad dgra la= mdze nag 'brum nag dgra la= sib dang bas ldag dgra la= dreg dang grum bu dgra la= lhog pa 'bras chen dgra la= skem pa g.yem pa dgra la= shu ba rgya thor dgra la= rlung skam 'bras chen dgra la= phol mig skem pa dgra la= tshab dang sna nad dgra la= bh+yoḥ nub kyi dmar mo dred gdong mas// rims nad sna lnga dgra la= klad gzer bal nad dgra la= rgyu gzer bal tshad dgra la= glo snying rims gzer dgra la= bh+yoḥ byang gi nag mo dom gdong mas// mtshon 'khrug sna bdun dgra la= mda' gri mdung gri dgra la= kha ṭ+wāṃ tri shul dgra la= sgyogs dang 'ur rdo dgra la= mtshon 'khrug bskal pa dgra la= sarba dhā ki nī bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlogs/ bh+yoḥ gzhan yang zlog cing sgyur ba ni// lha chen drag po'i gdug rtsub zlog /lha chad gnam nas babs pa zlog /lha ma yin gyi rgyu thabs zlog /skem byed lcags kyus zin pa zlog

/ma mo'i thun sngags dmag tshogs zlog /phra men ma yi nye dbye= sa bdag klu yi gdug rtsub= pho nya'i rbod gtong byung ba= phur pa'i dbal kha 'phen pa= yungs zor mda' ltar 'phen pa= mu stegs bon po'i byad zor= ban+de'i hom spar ngan sngags= zhang zhung chen po'i dzo dmar= sum pa'i glang thabs ling skyas= me nyag ltag pa'i 'phong len= khyung po'i glang btsan ngan 'thab= mu stegs phyi pa'i ngan sngags= yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa= mas kyi sri ru ldang ba= dpral ba'i gshed du 'khor ba= ltag pa'i bdud du babs pa= pho sri mo sri che sri= chung sri phung sri dbul sri= pha myes dur sri btsan sri= bdud kyi ltas ngan phyag brnyan= lo kag ke 'u gshed bzhi= lo keg zla keg zhag keg= sa la zhag rtsis 'debs pa= gnam la grangs rtsis 'debs pa= gza' skar lo keg zla keg= dus tshod rtsis la 'debs pa= gshed kha rbod gtod thams cad= gnam nas dal kha babs pa= sa yi mi kha byung ba= thog dang ser ba 'beb pa= bya nyes mna' grib ngan pa= yul mi khyim mtshes dmod mo= g.yas na pho brgya'i mda' bdar= g.yon na mo brgya'i dug g.yos= mdun nas rtsang bzhin 'dzug pa= rgyab nas khyi bzhin 'brang ba= mo ngan sog par sdigs pa= ngos la gdong thug byed pa= lkog na 'bu bzhin g.yeng ba= lus la na tsha gtong ba= sems la sdug bsngal gtong ba= tshe la bar chad byed pa= kha rje za kha dgag pa= mo ngan pra ngan sdigs pa= rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa= ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig= ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu= glo bur dgu bcu go gcig= dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad= pha tshan nang gi rgyab 'dre= ma tshan nang gi stong 'dre= ma bu'i byur 'dre zlog tu gsol// pha bu'i phung 'dre zlog tu gsol/ byur gyi sna 'dre byed pa= mi kha bra mchu zlog tu= chag chen nyam nga zlog tu gsol// hūm̐: smug nag g.yag gi mgo bo can: phyag na zhing dbyug bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la rol:

zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus la babs: dmar ser sbrul gyi mgo bo can: phyag na spu gri bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus la babs: dkar dmar sre mong mgo bo can: phyag na zhing dbyug bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i pags la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= ser nag pha wang mgo bo can: phyag na zhing dbyug bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i rus la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar ser dred kyi mgo bo can: phyag na zhing dbyug bhan dmar thogs: dam nyams dgra bo'i rgyus la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar ser dom gyi mgo bo can: phyag na dbyug to bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= sngo nag chu srin mgo bo can: phyag na bam ril bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i dbugs la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= sngo skya sdig pa'i mgo bo can: phyag na glo snying bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= ser nag khra yi mgo bo can: phyag na be con dung dmar bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i glo snying rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= mthing nag stag gi mgo bo can: phyag na zhing dbyug bhan+dha bsnams: dgra bo'i rgyu khrag longs la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar nag bya rgod mgo bo can: phyag na lcags sgrog bhan dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i dbang po lnga la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar nag rta yi mgo bo can: phyag na thod dbyug bhan+dha bsnams: dgra bo'i phung po lnga la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar ser byi la'i mgo bo can: phyag na spu gri bhan+dha bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= ser nag gzig gi mgo bo can: phyag na rdor dbyug bhan dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i khams chen bco brgyad rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar ser khyung gi mgo bo can:

phyag na rdo rje bhan dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i skye mched bcu gnyis rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar nag khyi yi mgo bo can: phyag na tsit+ta bhan dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dkar dmar pu shud mgo bo can: phyag na pad+ma bhan dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i yan lag lnga la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= ljang ser sha ba'i mgo bo can: phyag na zhing chen bhan dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i snying khrag rtsa la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar nag khwa ta'i mgo bo can: phyag na rnge'u chung bhan dmar bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i mgo la rol: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= ljang nag srin bya'i mgo bo can: phyag na rgyu zhags bhan dmar bsnams: phung thabs sna tshogs dgra la thongs: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar ser phag gi mgo bo can: phyag na rtse lnga bhan dmar bsnams: mdze rigs bco brgyad dgra la thongs: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= ser nag kyung ka'i mgo bo can: phyag na rgyu zhags bhan dmar bsnams: smyo ba'i nyes lnga dgra la thongs: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= ljang nag ba glang mgo bo can: phyag na zhing bam bhan+dha bsnams: mtshon 'khrug lceb gri dgra la thongs: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= sngo skya bya rog mgo bo can: phyag na zangs gri bhan dmar bsnams: dus 'khrug mtshon char dgra la thongs: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= nag mo khu byug mgo bo can: phyag na lcags kyu bhan dmar bsnams: dal yams sna tshogs dgra la thongs: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= sngon mo ra yi mgo bo can: phyag na zhags pa dung dmar bsnams: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= dmar mo spre 'u'i mgo bo can: phyag na lcags sgrog bhan dmar bsnams: ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la thongs: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus= ljang nag spyang mo'i mgo bo can: phyag na dril bu bhan+dha bsnams: gtad khram sel ngan dgra la thongs:

zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus la babs: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad pa'i: ma tshogs dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis: sngon tshe dpal chen spyan snga ru: bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes shing: dgra bgegs bsgral bar dam bcas pa'i: khas blang dam bcas ma g.yel bar: brnag pa'i las la mthu ma chung: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: brnags pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol: pha rol rbod gtong rbad 'dre zlog: chag chen nyam nga thams cad zlog: zlog cing sgyur ba'i las mdzod cig: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu= gro bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig= dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad= bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams= stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams= rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa= rbod gtong rbad 'dre thams cad= byad zor gtad kha thams cad= lha 'dre'i dal kha babs pa= gnam la bya rgod sder 'dzing= sa la gcan zan mche 'dzing= yul du wa spyang ngu ba= 'ug pa ha ha rgod pa= srin byas ro byung zer ba= srod la khyim byas 'bod pa= nam gung 'og rta 'tsher ba= tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba= steng nas gza' skar dal kha= 'og nas klu yi gtong rigs= bar nas sde brgyad g.yos pa= zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlogs: sgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: badz+ra ma nu rak+sha sī bh+yo: brah+ma ṇi bh+yo: ro'u trī ma bh+yo: bha na bhe bh+yo: ku mā rī bh+yo: in+d+ra ma bh+yo: kā la ma bh+yo: badz+ra piṅka la ma bh+yo: a mṛtaṃ bh+yo: so'u ma bh+yo: ta na taṃ bh+yo: rak+sha sī bh+yo: bhak+ṣa sī bh+yo: tsa ka la ma bh+yo: badz+ra ra tri ma bh+yo: ru dhi ra ma bh+yo: e ka tsa ra ma bh+yo: ma nu ha raṃ bh+yo: sid+dhi kaṃ bh+yo: bhā ya bhe bh+yo: ku la ma bh+yo: badz+ra mā ra ṇa bh+yo: ag+na ye bh+yo: bha rā hī bh+yo: tsa mun+t+ri bh+yo: u dha ma bh+yo: ba ru ṇa bh+yo: laṃ bo dhā ra bh+yo:

de nas gtor chung sha dum dang bcas pa lnga bshams la bran/ de dag so sor 'bum lam dus gcig 'bul kyang chog ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ bh+yoḥ ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma// byad kha thams cad zlog mdzad ma// sku mdog dmar nag lcags sreg mdog /gnam lcags thog gi tshwa tshwa 'phro/ khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// phyag na zangs gri thod khrag 'dzin// sku smad lcags sreg phur pa 'gril// gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma gzir// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas rigs kyi byad kha zlog /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// shar nas dkar mo seng gdong ma// phyag na zangs gri thod khrag 'dzin/ khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// sku smad lcags sreg phur pa 'gril// gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma gzir// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rdo rje rigs kyi byad kha zlog /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// lho nas ser mo stag gdong ma// phyag na zangs gri thod khrag 'dzin/ khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// sku smad lcags sreg phur pa 'gril// gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma gzir// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rin chen rigs kyi byad kha zlog /bcol pa'i phrin las= nub nas dmar mo dred gdong ma// phyag na zangs gri thod khrag 'dzin/ khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// sku smad lcags sreg phur pa 'gril// gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma gzir// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// pad+ma rigs kyi byad kha zlog /bcol pa'i phrin las= byang nas nag mo dom gdong ma// phyag na zangs gri thod khrag 'dzin/ khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// sku smad lcags sreg phur pa 'gril// gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma gzir// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// las kyi rigs kyi byad kha zlog /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bh+yoḥ

rdo rje dbang phyug ma bdun ni// srin mo tshangs ma la sogs pa// rig 'dzin kun gyi yum gcig ma/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag gi ma// yum gcig dpal gyi gtor ma 'di// nyams pa'i dgra dang lhan cig bzhes// rin chen dbang phyug sring bdun ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi la sogs pa// rig 'dzin kun gyi sring mo ste/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag gi sring*// sring gcig dpal gyi gtor ma 'di// nyams pa'i dgra dang lhan cig bzhes// pad+ma dbang phyug mdza' bdun ni// dga' ba stobs chen la sogs pa// rig 'dzin kun gyi mdza' mo ste/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs// grogs gcig dpal gyi gtor ma 'di// nyams pa'i dgra dang lhan cig bzhes// las kyi dbang phyug bran bdun ni// gsod byed me mo la sogs pa// rig 'dzin kun gyi bran mo ste/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag gi bran// bran gcig dpal gyi gtor ma 'di// nyams pa'i dgra dang lhan cig bzhes// hūm̐/ gdug rtsub drag po'i zor mdos kyis// da ni zlog sgyur dus la babs// steng phyogs lha yi gdug pa dang*// 'og phyogs klu yi gdug pa dang*// bar snang gnyan gyi gdug rtsub rnams// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu gsol// lo ni rgyal po'i keg chen dang*// zla ba blon po'i mchid 'tshal dang*// zhag ni dmag mi'i sna drangs rnams// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= dus tshod mtshon cha'i bdud gcod dang*// dgra 'dre byur gsum mi kha rnams// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= spar kha rus pa'i gting chag dang*// sme ba sha yi rgya ral dang*// dar rgud lpags pa ral pa rnams// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= shing sogs 'byung lnga'i sa bdag dang*// snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyis// bsam sbyor gdug rtsub ngan pa rnams// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang*// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*// ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu rnams// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu=

sre mong byi 'u khyer ba de// nal phrug 'ong ba'i ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= rmos glang bres la mkhun pa ni// sa bdag gnod pa'i ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= sbra yi gung shing chag pa de// lha 'dre gyes pa'i ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= ri dwags khyim du 'ong ba ni// ma dang bu yi nal sdig yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= ra lug shwa 'ud khyer ba ni// yul bud 'ong ba'i ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= sbal sbrul khyim du 'ong ba ni// bu sring byed pa'i ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= dril rtas rnga rngog 'cha' ba ni// mtshon cha g.yo ba'i ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= lug sha lag pra ngan pa dang*// ra lug chad lhag mang ba rnams// sog pa'i me long rdol ba dang*// rims nad 'ong ba'i ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= pha spun zor kha sdig pa dang*// ltas ngan bye brag mang ba rnams// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= 'ug pa sgo nas rgod pa dang*// srin byas nyin par kus 'debs rnams// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= sgo khyis ngu zug byed pa ni// bu tsha dwa 'ur lus pa'i ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu= byi long lam khar mang ba dang*// bud med nag mo'i co 'dzing ni// nye ba kun gyi ltas ngan yin// dmar nag zor gyis zlog tu gsol// skyes pa pho yi rus 'dre sgyur// za ma mo yi dkor 'dre sgyur// gnyen phyogs gnyen 'dre 'khor ba sgyur du gsol// pha myes mtshun 'dre sgyur du gsol// ltas ngan che dgu sgyur du gsol/ khang khyim bkrag mdangs sgyur du gsol// dur sar wa mo brgyal ba zlog /de phos srod la 'bod pa= tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba= phu yi sha pho ru 'dzing= mda' yi nya mo rnga 'dzing= bar gyi rgod po sder 'dzing= srin byas phung phung zer ba=

sbrul nag lam khar nyal ba= phyugs kyi 'gram 'khrug ngan pa= mtshe ma mang ba zlog cing sgyur du gsol// zlog sgyur chen po'i dus la babs// sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo zlogs zlogs/ de yan bzlog pa'i gzhung de nyid// zhag gsum lnga bdun la sogs pa// sgrub na nyin rer dus gsum 'don// nyin rdzogs byed na tshar grangs ni// gsum lnga bdun dgu skabs dang sbyar// de nas 'bul khar dkar gtor 'bul// spyi ltar gser skyems mchod byas la/ khyim der rkyen ngan chag chen na/ khyim de'i phyogs ni gtsang phyogs su// sla nga'i nang du liṅga bzhag /dgug gzhug byas la zor rnams ni// bsrung bya yon bdag thams cad kyi// gcig gis gcig gtad lag 'grim byas// dang po slob dpon nyid kyis gtad// mthar ni mchod g.yog pa gcig gis// liṅga nyid la rgyab tu bcug /ri la 'bul na phyogs gtsang sar// liṅga bcug la dgug gzhug byas// sngags pa nyid kyis liṅgar brgyab// dmag thabs yin phyir bskul ba yang*// 'di ltar go ldog mjug nas 'don// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// bden grub kun gyi bden stobs dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i mthu stobs kyis// bdag dang bsrung bya 'di dag la// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa yi// nad dang gdon dang bar chad rkyen// byad kha chag chen nyam nga kun// liṅga 'di la myur du khug /badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rol chen dang bcas lan gsum brjod/ bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed ma: ma tshogs dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang: g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pas: sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi: gtsug tu blangs te bkur bar bya'o: de skad khyed kyis zhal bzhes pas: dpal gyi bka' bzhin bdag bsgrub kyis: 'dir byon bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo:

gsod byed ljang nag ral gri 'phyar: spyang mo'i mgo can dus la babs: me mo dmar mo gsal shing 'dzin: skyin bu'i mgo can dus= phag mo nag mo mche zhags bsnams: phag gi mgo can dus= rgan byed dmar mo zhing chung za: khwa ta'i mgo can dus= sna chen dkar mo thod khrag 'thung: ba glang mgo can dus= chu lha sngon mo sbrul zhags 'dzin: bya rog mgo can dus= gsus 'dzin ser nag dril bu 'dzin: skya ga'i mgo can dus= mngags shing bskul ba nga yis byed: bcol ba'i phrin las khyed kyis mdzod: bh+yo sa ya si: gnod byed dgra bgegs ma rā ya thun bh+yo: zhes byang gi zor chung bdun sngags te brjod cing 'phang ngo*// de bzhin du/ bh+yo: dga' ba dmar mo rke dar 'chang: bya rgod mgo can dus la babs: stobs chen dkar mo thong gshol 'dzin: rta yi mgo can dus= gcig spyod sngon mos spu gris gcod: byi la'i mgo can dus= 'dod pa dmar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs: khyi yi mgo can dus= nor srung dkar mo bum pa 'dzin: pu shud mgo can dus= rlung lha sngon mo ba dan 'phyar: sha ba'i mgo can dus= bum sna dmar nag lcags sgrog bsnams: spre 'u'i mgo can dus= mngags shing bskul ba nga yis byed: bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mdzod: bh+yo sa ya si: gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya thun bh+yo: zhes nub kyi zor chung bdun 'phang ngo*// bh+yo: rdo rje ser mo khrag chen 'thung: dom gyi mgo can dus la babs: bdud rtsi dmar mo bum pa 'dzin: chu srin mgo can dus= zla ba dkar mo pun+dha 'dzin: sdig pa'i mgo can dus= be con mthing nag dbyug tho 'phyar: khra yi mgo can dus= srin mo dmar mo dung khrag 'thung: wa yi mgo can dus= za ba ljang nag ba su 'dren: stag gi mgo can dus= ra gdong sngon mo zhags pa thogs: ra yi mgo can dus= mngags shing bskul ba nga yis byed: bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mdzod: bh+yo sa ya si: gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya thun bh+yo:

lho'i zor chung bdun 'phang*/ bh+yo: srin mo smug nag thod rlon 'chang: g.yag gi mgo can dus la babs: tshangs pa dmar ser pad+ma 'dzin: sbrul gyi mgo can dus= lha chen dkar ljang tri shul thogs: gzig gi mgo can dus= gtog 'dod sngon mo 'khor lo 'chang: sre mong mgo can dus= gzhon nu dmar mo mdung thung 'phen: phag gi mgo can dus= brgya byin dkar mo in+t+ra gdengs: khyung gi mgo can dus= rdo rje nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin: khu byug mgo can dus= mngags shing bskul ba nga yis byed: bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mdzod: bh+yo sa ya si: gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya thun bh+yo: shar gyi zor chung bdun 'phang*/ sa: dom gdong nag mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: karma rigs kyi byad ma zlogs: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag gyur cig: ( bh+yo hūm̐ tri ma nu khrom bh+yo: du du tsa sha nan: a ka ma ni khroṃ bh+yo: shad bu gyad bu nan: sa ra ma ni khroṃ bh+yo: tra ni tra ni nan: ni li dha ra khroṃ bh+yo: tri phuṃ tri phuṃ nan: tri sha tra khroṃ bh+yo: dun ting du nan: a hrī ni sa bh+yo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya phaṭa: bh+yo sa ya si: ) gong gi bsnyen pa'i sngags ring brjod cing byang gi gtor ma byang du gdengs tsam byas la liṅgar brgyab/ de bzhin du/ ni: dred gdong dmar mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: pad+ma rigs kyi byad ma zlogs: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag gyur cig: nub kyi/ hrī: stag gdong ser mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: rin chen rigs kyi byad ma zlogs: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag gyur cig:

lho'i/ a: seng gdong dkar mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: rdo rje rigs kyi byad ma zlogs: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag gyur cig: shar gyi/ hūm̐: byad zlog lha mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: sangs rgyas rigs kyi byad ma zlogs: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag gyur cig: ces dbus kyi gtor ma 'phang*/ de nas zor rnams thams cad bsdus byas la// gtor ma'i rigs rnams bya khyir za rgyu gtor// rtsang rnams thams cad bsdus te me la bsreg / byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams: ma mo mkha' 'gro bzhugs pa'i gnas: byang shar chos kyi dbyings su gshegs: sarba dz+nyā na dhā ki nī shwa rī badz+ra mu: de nas gtor snod thams cad mdun du sbubs/ ri la yin na dar nag dril te steng du bzung*/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa: rang nyid dran rdzogs mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin zhing gar stabs mdzad: gnod byed gdon bgegs dam sri thams cad rnams: rgya khab sa 'bol nang du btab pa ltar: rim dgu sa yi 'og tu tal ler song: gtor gzhong ri rab gling bzhis steng nas mnan: byams mgon ma byon bar du ma ldangs shig: rdo rjes rgya gram du rgyas btab la/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: de nas phyir mig mi blta nang du log /bkra shis gang shes brjod pa ma gtogs pa// rjes chog gzhan ni 'di la mi dgos so// spar kha li la rtsub pa'i spar kha'i bcos// byad zlog rigs ni 'di las rno ba med// nad rims rkyen ngan drag po kun la phan// de phyir dbang phyug ma yi zor mdos 'di// mo rtsis gzhung chen kun nas lung ston pas// ji bzhin shes mkhan nyin mo'i skar ma tsam// sngar gyi rnying ma'i dpe rgyud 'ga' mchis kyang*// cha lag ma tshang dbang lung brgyud pa chad// de phyir dgongs gter nang nas phyung ba yi// don bkrol phyag len gtan la phab pa yin// dbang gi dus sam yang na zor gyi dus// zor de tshur la log par gyur pa na// mkha' 'gro ma dga' ba yi rtags yin pas// rjes nas bskang thung tshar grangs mang zhig 'don// 'di yi dbang lung bka' gtad zhu ba'i dus// yon du mtshon cha phul na phan thogs che// ma 'ongs 'gro la phan pa'i sems bskyed nas// gter blon rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pa yin// yi ge pa ni dge slong brtson 'grus yin// nyes 'gal mchis na ma mo mkha' 'gror bshags// dge bas phan thogs rgya cher 'byung bar
